answer: Through the echo, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. A per-answer bond aligns incentives: good work gets it back with the reward, copy-paste work loses it. The cipher makes the attacker's unit economics collapse — every clone that submits junk pays for the privilege, and the graders earn from catching them. The sparrow does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
